biomarkers.name: JAK2 / CALR / MPL testing
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; many cases lack a defining driver, but testing is part of standard evaluation to exclude/classify other MPNs
biomarkers.clinical_use: Standard MPN workup; helps exclude/classify other MPNs and assess clonality

biomarkers.name: BCR::ABL1 testing
biomarkers.clinical_use: Required to exclude CML in the diagnostic evaluation

biomarkers.name: CSF3R testing
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; assessed when neutrophilic phenotype is present
biomarkers.clinical_use: Used to exclude chronic neutrophilic leukemia in appropriate clinical/morphologic context

biomarkers.name: KIT D816V / other systemic mastocytosis-associated testing
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; assessed when mast cell disease is suspected
biomarkers.clinical_use: Used to exclude systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm when clinically indicated

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: MPN features not fitting PV, ET, PMF, CML, or other defined MPN entities

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC with MPN features not fitting defined entities
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Residual category being narrowed by modern classification
